The peak of the blue line at layer 8 is visually at 0.5, which is exactly halfway between the 0.4 and 0.6 gridlines. The value 0.47 is an inaccurate approximation.

errors.text_span: fluctuating between approximately 0.2 and 0.45 through layer 20

The description incorrectly identifies these layers as crossing points with the mean line. In the plot, the blue line is above the mean at layers 5 and 10, and below the mean at layers 15 and 20. The actual crossings happen at different layer values.
The x-axis does not range to 25. The last visible tick mark is at 20, and the data line ends at approximately layer 23.
The solid blue line in the chart does not have any markers.

errors.text_span: exhibits a general upward trend with fluctuations
errors.evidence: This description is an oversimplification of the line's movement. The score rises steeply, then fluctuates at a higher level, and finally drops. It is not a 'general upward trend' across the whole range.
The data line ends at approximately layer 23, not layer 25.
The plot shows a dip to approximately 0.03 at layer 2, not layer 1. At layer 1, the value is higher than at layer 0, at approximately 0.06.

errors.text_span: fluctuates between roughly 0.2 and 0.4 across layers 10 to 23
errors.evidence: The stated fluctuation range of 0.2 to 0.4 is incorrect for layers 10 to 23. In this interval, the line goes above 0.4 (e.g., to approx. 0.43 at layer 14) and significantly below 0.2 (e.g., to approx. 0.17 at layer 21 and 0.12 at layer 23).
